description: This Java class defines a response message for sending a message from a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and setting headers, specifically for responses to 'SendThingMessage' commands.

classes.name: SendThingMessageResponse
classes.description: A final class representing a response message for sending a message from a Thing, parameterized by payload type T.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the response, returning a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of SendThingMessageResponse, either from ThingId or String, message, status code, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SendThingMessageResponse instance from a JSON string or JSON object, with associated headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Checks if another object is an instance of SendThingMessageResponse for equality purposes.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
